steps.label: Bills expected before payday (2)
steps.basis: each bill's 12-month average, on its usual day of the month

assumptions: Payday is taken as day 15 of the month, the usual day in this customer's history.
The projection assumes bills and everyday spending follow their 12-month averages. A large one-off purchase would change it.
Only this account is visible. Money held elsewhere is not counted.
"Comfortable" means at least 1 month of must-pay costs is still covered just before payday. "Tight" means the balance stays above zero but below that.
An average month leaves nothing over after spending, so saving up would need a change first.
